summary: I walked the diff against the pinned spec text for %TypedArray%.prototype.set, SetTypedArrayFromTypedArray and SetTypedArrayFromArrayLike. Steps are implemented in spec order, and each abrupt completion is propagated with `?`. The RequireInternalSlot, ToIntegerOrInfinity, negative-offset RangeError, content-type check (which runs before the offset RangeErrors, as in the spec), the +∞ and length RangeErrors, the clone-on-same-buffer path, the element-wise copy loop, and the ArrayLike Get/TypedArraySetElement loop all match the spec. I found no test-shaped branches and no made-up return values. The one hardcoded constant, sameSharedArrayBuffer = false, follows from the diff's own note that no SharedArrayBuffer exists, so it is not a defect. The four lint flags are `expect` calls on invariants: the first two follow the earlier typed-array check, and the buffer `expect` calls are not proven unreachable. Those are worth a look but are not spec or error-handling defects in this diff.
